comment: arc.aiAwareness: chance that an AI sees a given arc coming (drawn again each cycle), so that they get caught now and then. Obstacles of the arena (Obstacles.cs): lasting features of the ground, unlike terrain. solid: blocks everyone and every shot (a wall); fall: a Pokémon whose centre gets in (pushed, sliding, dashing) falls, unless its movementType is in passTypes (ROM: 2 float, 3 through walls, 4 lava, 5 swim), and comes back to the last safe tile, losing fallDamage of its max HP (+ fallStatus). Walking never takes anyone in: the controllers stop at the edge. speedMul / slideAccel: like terrains, for walkable obstacles. holdsTerrain: terrain may lie on it (electrified water). shotsPass: projectiles fly over it (true unless solid). tileset: ROM dungeon tileset whose secondary layer (water, lava or void, with PMD's own banks) draws it, extracted by Tools/setup.py into Assets/Resources/ObstacleTiles; otherwise the hand-made sheet obstacle_<key> of Resources/Effects (overlay: drawn over what it covers, like a bridge over the void); color: fallback look when neither exists. interactions: a move of type 'byType' (ROM type id) hitting the obstacle 'on', or terrain 'byTerrain' laid on it or on a tile next to it, turns it into 'becomes' ('' removes it), for 'duration' seconds then back to 'on' (0: for good); path: also along the flight of a projectile (an ice beam freezing a river); spread: the change then runs along the connected tiles of 'on' and of 'spreadOver', spreadDelay seconds a tile; radius: tiles around the hit; paintTerrain: instead, paints that terrain on the whole connected obstacle for 'duration' seconds; leaves: terrain painted where the obstacle was removed. decaysTo / decayTime: what an obstacle becomes by itself after that many seconds (a burning bridge burns out); planks, flatAlpha: provisional look. romRocks: ROM rocks drawing it (Tools/pmd/extract_rock.py; cut 'core' also removes a shadow on grass), one per tile (ownRocks: always these, never the rock cut from the arena's décor); oneWay: a ledge, (x, y) the only way across it (jumping down), standing on it carries the Pokémon down; hidden: drawn by the map, not by the obstacles; spriteTint: colour over its sprite; bumpStun / bumpDamage: a Pokémon thrown (pushed, sliding) against this solid obstacle is stunned and hurt; anchorTypes / anchorDefense: these types cannot be pushed on it and take less damage (Acier on metal); magnetRadius / magnetPull / captureRadius / attractTypes: a magnet drags the Pokémon and catches the shots of these types. interactions: action (overcharge, ground: pylons), floodKind (paintTerrain over the obstacle of that kind next to the hit). arc: the pylons' arc (Pylons.cs): rest / warn / active seconds, width, damage, status, stun, immune types, typeDamage (Vol × 1.5), what overcharges or grounds a pylon, conducts (an arc over water or metal electrifies all of it), hazardCost for the AIs. passPokemonTypes: Pokémon types that cross it too (ROM movement type or Pokémon type, either is enough; Spectre walk through solids, shots do not); toll: what a type pays over it when that type is its only way across (damageShare per second, status + statusChance per second); easyTypes: types it neither slows down nor makes slide. easyMovementTypes: ROM movement types it leaves alone too; sinkTime / sinkStatus / sinkDuration: standing in it that long gives that status (quicksand: trapped); navCost: extra path cost for the AIs it hinders.
